proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4780 cikka explicitly gives Punjabi cikkaṛ, Hindi cīkaṛ and the kṭg. addendum cikṛɔ mud. These cikaṛ/cikaḍ forms fit the r/ḍ extension of this sticky-matter family; its remote origin is debated. Exact survey form cikaṛ is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
